title: ScriptManifest
description: Manifest for operator-invoked and event-triggered scripts (§22.3). Scripts are single executable files in ~/.hoop/scripts/<name> with optional manifest.yml metadata.

name.description: Script name (must match the executable filename)

description.description: Human-readable description of what the script does

scope.description: Visibility scope: 'global' scripts appear everywhere, 'project' scripts only on matching projects

projects.description: List of project names where this script is available (only used when scope=project)

arguments.description: Optional argument schema for UI prompts

schedule.description: Cron schedule for automatic execution (5-field format: min hour dom month dow). Example: '0 4 * * *' for daily at 4 AM.

overlap_policy.description: How to handle overlapping executions: 'skip' (default) skips if previous run is still active, 'queue' waits for previous run to finish, 'parallel' allows concurrent runs

event.description: Event pattern to match (glob pattern, e.g., 'stitch.*', 'bead.closed')

project.description: Project name filter (exact match or glob)

on.description: Event subscriptions - when matching events fire, this script runs with event JSON on stdin
